title: Wireplumber
description: The wireplumber module displays the current volume reported by WirePlumber.

placeholders.description: Volume in percentage, cubic scale as integer.
Volume in linear scale as float.
Volume in cubic scale as float.
Volume in decibel scale as float.
The node's nickname as reported by WirePlumber (node.nick property)
Source (microphone) volume in percentage, cubic scale as integer.
Source (microphone) volume in linear scale as float.
Source (microphone) volume in cubic scale as float.
Source (microphone) volume in decibel scale as float.
The source node's nickname/description as reported by WirePlumber.
The pre-rendered source (microphone) volume sub-string, formatted with format-source/format-source-muted.

format.label: What to show
format.doc: The format, how information should be displayed. This format is used when other formats aren't specified.
format.description: The text shown in the bar. Words in curly braces, like {icon}, are replaced with live values: see the list of placeholders.

format-muted.label: What to show when muted
format-muted.doc: This format is used when the sound is muted.
format-muted.description: This format is used when the sound is muted.

format-bluetooth.label: What to show using Bluetooth
format-bluetooth.doc: This format is used when the active sink is a Bluetooth device (its node name contains bluez or a2dp-sink).
format-bluetooth.description: This format is used when the active sink is a Bluetooth device (its node name contains bluez or a2dp-sink).

format-bluetooth-muted.label: What to show using Bluetooth and muted
format-bluetooth-muted.doc: This format is used when the active sink is a Bluetooth device and the sound is muted.
format-bluetooth-muted.description: This format is used when the active sink is a Bluetooth device and the sound is muted.

format-source.label: What to show for the microphone
format-source.doc: The format used to render the source (microphone) volume sub-string that is exposed through the {format_source} replacement.
format-source.description: The format used to render the source (microphone) volume sub-string that is exposed through the {format_source} replacement.

format-source-muted.label: What to show when the microphone is muted
format-source-muted.doc: The format used for the {format_source} sub-string when the source (microphone) is muted.
format-source-muted.description: The format used for the {format_source} sub-string when the source (microphone) is muted.

format-icons.label: Icons
format-icons.doc: Based on the current volume, the corresponding icon gets selected. The order is low to high.
format-icons.description: The icons used for {icon}. When it is a list, the first icon is used for the lowest level and the last one for the highest.

node-type.label: Node type
node-type.doc: The WirePlumber node type to attach to. Use Audio/Source to manage microphones etc.
node-type.description: The WirePlumber node type to attach to. Use Audio/Source to manage microphones etc.

only-physical.label: Only physical
only-physical.doc: When enabled, resolve through virtual/filter-chain sinks to the underlying physical sink and report its volume instead.
only-physical.description: When enabled, resolve through virtual/filter-chain sinks to the underlying physical sink and report its volume instead.

tooltip.label: Show tooltip
tooltip.doc: Option to disable tooltip on hover.
tooltip.description: Show a small popup with more details when the mouse is over the module.

tooltip-format.label: Tooltip text
tooltip-format.doc: The format of information displayed in the tooltip.
tooltip-format.description: What the popup shows. It uses the same placeholders as the bar text.

rotate.label: Rotation
rotate.doc: Positive value to rotate the text label (in 90 degree increments).
rotate.description: Rotate the text. Mostly useful on vertical bars.

states.label: Levels
states.doc: A number of volume states which get activated on certain volume levels. See waybar-states(5).
states.description: Give names to value ranges (for example "warning" at 30 and "critical" at 15). You can then use a different format or color for each level.

max-length.label: Maximum length
max-length.doc: The maximum length in character the module should display.
max-length.description: Cut the text when it is longer than this. Empty means no limit.

min-length.label: Minimum length
min-length.doc: The minimum length in characters the module should accept.
min-length.description: Keep the module at least this wide, so the bar doesn't jump around when the text changes.

align.label: Text position
align.doc: The alignment of the label within the module, where 0 is left-aligned and 1 is right-aligned. If the module is rotated, it will follow the flow of the text.
align.description: Where the text sits inside the module: 0 is left, 0.5 is center, 1 is right.

justify.label: Line alignment
justify.doc: The alignment of the text within the module's label, allowing options 'left', 'right', or 'center' to define the positioning.
justify.description: How lines are aligned when the text has more than one line.

scroll-step.label: Scroll step
scroll-step.doc: The speed at which to change the volume when scrolling.
scroll-step.description: The speed at which to change the volume when scrolling.

scroll-scale.label: Scroll scale
scroll-scale.doc: The scale to use for the scrolling volume change. Options are 'linear', 'db', 'cubic', and 'cubic_percent'.
scroll-scale.description: The scale to use for the scrolling volume change. Options are 'linear', 'db', 'cubic', and 'cubic_percent'.

reverse-scrolling.label: Reverse touchpad scrolling
reverse-scrolling.doc: Option to reverse the scroll direction for touchpads.
reverse-scrolling.description: Swap up and down when scrolling with a touchpad.

reverse-mouse-scrolling.label: Reverse mouse scrolling
reverse-mouse-scrolling.doc: Option to reverse the scroll direction for mice.
reverse-mouse-scrolling.description: Swap up and down when scrolling with a mouse wheel.

on-click.label: Left click runs
on-click.doc: Command to execute when clicked on the module.
on-click.description: A command to run when you click the module. Empty keeps the normal behavior.

on-click-middle.label: Middle click runs
on-click-middle.doc: Command to execute when middle-clicked on the module using mousewheel.
on-click-middle.description: A command to run when you click the module with the mouse wheel.

on-click-right.label: Right click runs
on-click-right.doc: Command to execute when you right-click on the module.
on-click-right.description: A command to run when you right-click the module.

on-update.label: On every refresh run
on-update.doc: Command to execute when the module is updated.
on-update.description: A command to run each time the module updates.

on-scroll-up.label: Scroll up runs
on-scroll-up.doc: Command to execute when scrolling up on the module. This replaces the default behaviour of volume control.
on-scroll-up.description: A command to run when you scroll up over the module. It replaces what scrolling normally does.

on-scroll-down.label: Scroll down runs
on-scroll-down.doc: Command to execute when scrolling down on the module. This replaces the default behaviour of volume control.
on-scroll-down.description: A command to run when you scroll down over the module. It replaces what scrolling normally does.

max-volume.label: Max volume
max-volume.doc: The maximum volume that can be set, in percentage.
max-volume.description: The maximum volume that can be set, in percentage.

menu.label: Open popup menu with
menu.description: Which click opens a popup menu for this module.

menu-file.label: Menu layout file
menu-file.doc: Location of the menu descriptor file. There need to be an element of type GtkMenu with id menu
menu-file.description: The file that describes the menu entries (a GTK .xml file with a menu called "menu").

menu-actions.label: Menu commands
menu-actions.doc: The actions corresponding to the buttons of the menu.
menu-actions.description: For each menu entry, the command to run when you pick it.
